answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing identity and paying only for proven work. A new agent must lock a refundable bond and gather signed endorsements from three established peers, each charging a fee. Work routes by attested receipts: reputation accrues from outputs downstream agents consumed and verified, never from self-reported claims. A new identity must finish a real voyage of paid deliveries before it may vote or hold escrow. The bond is a jetty anchoring honest actors and exposing anyone who floods the registry, capital locked and slashable, an onyx mark peers read on the ledger.
